name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and successfully generated an MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API. The output file output.mp3 (44,765 bytes) was verified as a valid MPEG ADTS Layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, matching the requested mp3_44100_128 format.
deviations: The quickstart's final step uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. In this headless sandbox environment without audio hardware, I used `elevenlabs.play.save(audio, "output.mp3")` instead to write the generated audio to a file, allowing tangible verification that the API request succeeded and audio data was returned. The core API call and authentication followed the quickstart exactly.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
